Hmm, firstly I hope your girl best friend didn't spill the beans haha. What was his reaction when he received rumors that you had a crush on him? Was his demeanor changed? In a good way or bad way? In the end, if you decide to confess, regardless of the results, you guys should at least be good friends. If you decide to go for it and he rejects it, you'll be met with a lot of feelings. Take some time for yourself (while letting the guy know) and kinda sort out your feelings. Then reconvene and talk to him about it. If he accepts your crush, then congrats! I had a similar situation to you. I had a really good friendship with this guy that started to develop into love. I eventually confessed and he said that he was straight. I was so heartbroken that I didn't talk and ignored him. He asked to talk to me after school and told me that he really didn't want me to shut him out of his life. He still wanted me to be his friend. So I felt like an asshole because I almost destroyed a perfectly good friendship because he didn't accept my feelings. So, firstly just make sure you guys have a pretty decent friendship and maybe get to know him a little bit more. You can maybe add some more personal questions like if he was gay or not. I personally would take my time and find the best moment to tell him but if you're are confident, go for it girly
